proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ A B C hAB
  have hab : ((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hAB.card_ne_zero
  have ha : (A.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : A.Nonempty := hAB.mono Finset.inter_subset_left
    exact_mod_cast this.card_ne_zero
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (A B C : Finset Ω), (A ∩ B).Nonempty → ((A ∩ B ∩ C).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * (((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) / A.card) * (((A ∩ B ∩ C).card : ℝ) / (A ∩ B).card)
